mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.5% triggers central bank hawkishness, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate above 4.7% indicates labor market slack, reducing wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as rate hikes are delayed.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.7.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 110 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 110.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and GDPC1 exceed their 12-month averages.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5), a federal funds rate above 5.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5 and FEDFUNDS is above 5.0.
